gaps.sentence: He kept ___ even though everyone had left.
She denied ___ the last piece of cake.
He was ___ to resign after the scandal.
gaps.explanation: 'be forced to do' = be made to do unwillingly.

gaps.sentence: She made me ___ my homework before dinner.
gaps.explanation: 'make somebody do' — bare infinitive after the object.

gaps.sentence: The window has ___ been repaired, I'm glad to say.
gaps.explanation: 'Has since been repaired' = between that time and now.

gaps.sentence: I'd rather you ___ smoke in here.
They had no ___ but to call the police.
All the tickets ___ sold out by noon.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: had been + participle (before the stated past moment).
